name: pcetbase
title: PCETbase: solution-phase PCET thermochemistry (BDFE, E°, pKa)

fields.name: table
fields.description: Source table in Agarwal et al. Chem. Rev. 2022 (T5-T24) or EXT for primary-literature entries

fields.name: partner
fields.description: Base or acid partner for oxidant/base and reductant/acid pairs

fields.name: solvent
fields.description: Controlled vocabulary; see constants.csv for solvents with thermochemical constants

fields.name: E_a
fields.description: E°(X/X-) in V, vs Fc+/0 in organic solvents, vs SHE in water

fields.name: E_b
fields.description: E°(XH+/XH) in V, same scale as E_a

fields.name: pKa_a
fields.description: pKa(XH+)

fields.name: pKa_b
fields.description: pKa(XH)

fields.name: E_H2
fields.description: Canonical potential of hydrogenation, V vs H2 in the stated solvent

fields.name: BDFE
fields.description: Bond dissociation free energy, kcal/mol; effective BDFE for pairs; average over n_H where flagged avg

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-separated caveat flags; see README

fields.name: refs
fields.description: Original citation numbers inside the source compilation

fields.name: n_H
fields.description: Number of H atoms transferred

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Primary-source DOI for EXT entries

fields.name: BDFE_pub
fields.description: Published BDFE where it differs from the recomputed value

fields.name: E_raw
fields.description: Potential exactly as published, V

fields.name: E_raw_ref
fields.description: Reference electrode of E_raw; converted via refoff constants

fields.name: recommended
fields.description: 1 manual star, 0 manual suppress, auto = assigned by documented policy in build.py

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year; compilation year for review-tabulated rows

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: Stable entry identifier, never reused

fields.name: couple_id
fields.description: Foreign key to couples.csv; groups independent measurements of the same compound/partner/solvent couple

fields.name: sigma_BDFE
fields.description: Uncertainty of BDFE in kcal/mol: published value where given, otherwise adopted per method class (see CONTRIBUTING)

fields.name: T_K
fields.description: Temperature in K; empty = not stated in source (do not assume 298)

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Medium details: electrolyte and concentration, ionic strength, pH convention for aqueous entries (standard vs pH 7 effective)

fields.name: hydricity_kcal
fields.description: Hydricity dG(H-) in kcal/mol in the stated solvent, as published (TM hydrides; CR-2026-11-11-tmh-schema). Interconverts with BDFE via pKa, the two 1e potentials and the solvent H- scale constant (CHyd in constants.csv, from Wiedner Chem. Rev. 2016 Table 2).

fields.name: E_c
fields.description: E(X+/X*) in V on the row's stated reference scale: the one-electron couple above the X*/X- (E_a) couple, outside the X-H square scheme. Used with E_a in the hydricity closure (class tmh; CR-2026-11-12-tmh-wiedner Q3 decision: own column, no E_b overload).

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Provenance of the stored values (CR-2026-11-13-origin-provenance): exp = all legs measured; comp = defining value computed (DFT, simulation-only, empirical estimate); mixed = at least one leg computed or simulation-fitted, at least one measured; empty = not yet classified (classification is incremental, never guessed).

fields.name: key
fields.description: dGfH | CG | EH2vsFc | refoff:<ELECTRODE>

fields.name: value_kcal_or_V
fields.description: kcal/mol for dGfH and CG; V for potentials and offsets

fields.name: note
fields.description: For refoff rows: adopted uncertainty in V

fields.name: source
fields.description: Page-verified literature citation with DOI

fields.name: couple_id
fields.description: Stable couple identifier, never reused

fields.name: partner
fields.description: Empty except for oxidant/base and reductant/acid pairs

fields.name: class
fields.description: Same vocabulary as data.csv class

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Semicolon-separated alternative names for search (trivial names, abbreviations, InChIKey); e.g. 'hydroquinone;benzene-1,4-diol' for 1,4-H2Q

fields.name: recommended_reason
fields.description: One-line justification of the current star, reconstructable from the selection rules in CONTRIBUTING; required whenever any row of this couple has recommended=1 or 0

fields.name: discordant
fields.description: 1 = independent measurements of this couple disagree beyond combined uncertainty; spread shown in UI

resources.name: verification
resources.description: Build-generated verification ledger (CR-2026-11-13-verification-ledger): one row per entry_id recording how the value was obtained and checked. Regenerated by build.py; do not edit by hand - edit data/provenance_batches.csv / data/provenance_overrides.csv.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: Measurement this record describes (FK to data.entry_id).

fields.name: couple_id
fields.description: Couple of the entry.

fields.name: compound
fields.description: Compound (copied for readability).

fields.name: solvent
fields.description: Solvent (copied).

fields.name: class
fields.description: Class (copied).

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: review-table / review-SI-spreadsheet / primary / primary+review (from data/provenance_batches.csv + overrides).

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Where the stored values were read, e.g. 'Agarwal 2022 T6' or the primary paper.

fields.name: extraction_route
fields.description: How the values were extracted (image-read table, xlsx via openpyxl, primary PDF text layer, ...).

fields.name: primary_verified
fields.description: yes / no / partial - whether the stored legs were checked against the primary literature.

fields.name: introduced_in
fields.description: CR ID + PR number that added the row.

fields.name: last_modified_in
fields.description: PR of the last change to the row (from overrides; empty = unchanged since introduction).

fields.name: checks_run
fields.description: Semicolon list of the closures that apply: eq18, eq10, hyd.

fields.name: eq18_res
fields.description: eq 18 closure residual in kcal/mol (copied from derived/analysis.csv).

fields.name: eq10_res
fields.description: eq 10 closure residual in kcal/mol (copied).

fields.name: hyd_res
fields.description: Hydricity-diagonal residual in kcal/mol (copied).

fields.name: check_outcome
fields.description: pass (within validate.py soft thresholds) / soft (known deviation) / n/a.

fields.name: bdfe_pub_delta
fields.description: BDFE - BDFE_pub where a published BDFE exists.

fields.name: cross_checks
fields.description: Independent cross-checks: multi-member couple, second review, reference-scale check.

fields.name: spot_check
fields.description: Independent spot-check record (e.g. the 2026-11-12 stress-test sample).

fields.name: open_flags
fields.description: The row's flags, copied.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One generated plain-language line summarising source, route, checks and outcome.
